fact: 1947年1月1日为英国煤炭工业国有化「vesting day」，国家煤炭局（National Coal Board, NCB）正式接管958家煤矿；煤炭工业国有化法1946年7月12日获御准。

sources.title: Records created or inherited by the National Coal Board — The National Archives, UK
sources.quote: The Coal Industry Nationalisation Act 1946 provided for the complete nationalisation of the coal industry and on 12 July 1946 established the National Coal Board (NCB). This body, appointed on 15 July 1946, was made solely responsible for managing the industry and running it on business lines.

sources.title: Coal Industry Comes Under Public Ownership in Britain — History Today
sources.quote: Along with the setting up of the National Health Service, the nationalisation of the Coal mines, which officially took effect on New Year's Day, 1947, stands out as one of the legislative highlights of the great reforming post-war Labour Government in Britain.

fact: 1947年1-3月英国遭遇极寒冬季与燃料危机：煤炭库存告急，发电厂限电，工厂每周停工数天，约200万工人短期失业；这是二战后英国最严重的经济危机。

sources.title: Clement Attlee — GOV.UK (past Prime Ministers)
sources.quote: Coal Industry Nationalisation Act 1946, Electricity Act 1947, Transport Act 1947: nationalised the coal industry, electricity utilities, railways and long-distance haulage.

fact: 1947年7月15日英国按《英美财政协定》恢复英镑对美元的可兑换性；但仅数周内英镑大量外流，政府被迫于8月20日暂停可兑换，英镑-美元危机暴露了英国战后财政的脆弱。

sources.title: Clement Attlee — GOV.UK
sources.quote: Town and Country Planning Act 1947: planning permission now required for land development; ownership alone no longer sufficient.

fact: 英国在二战中积累了约35亿英镑的「英镑结存」（sterling balances），即英联邦国家因对英出口与驻军开支而持有的英镑债权；1947年这些结存构成英国对外短期债务的主体，印度与巴基斯坦要求分割其中约11.8亿英镑的对印结存。

sources.title: Agreement on Financial Issues — MEA, Government of India
sources.quote: Reimbursement by the Reserve Bank of India to the State Bank of Pakistan on account of remittance charges from Pakistan to India of Reserve Bank's chest balances of the 30th June, 1948.

fact: 英国是马歇尔计划最大受援国：1948-1952年英国共获得约27亿美元（约占马歇尔计划总额的26%），用于进口美国食品、燃料与原材料。

sources.title: Remarks by the Secretary of State at Harvard University on June 5, 1947 — George C. Marshall Foundation
sources.quote: The truth of the matter is that Europe's requirements for the next three or four years of foreign food and other essential products--principally from America--are so much greater than her present ability to pay that she must have substantial additional help, or face economic, social and political deterioration of a very grave character.

fact: 《1947年印度独立法》同时取消了英国王室的「印度皇帝」头衔；英国国王乔治六世自1947年8月15日起不再使用 Emperor of India 称号，英国君主的正式头衔相应修改。

sources.title: Indian Independence Act 1947, legislation.gov.uk
sources.quote: The assent of the Parliament of the United Kingdom is hereby given to the omission from the Royal Style and Titles of the words "Indiae Imperator" and the words "Emperor of India" and to the issue by His Majesty for that purpose of His Royal Proclamation under the Great Seal of the Realm.

fact: 1947年8月15日印度与巴基斯坦独立，标志着英国统治印度190年的结束；英国首相艾德礼在下议院宣布这一消息，帝国解体进入加速期。

sources.title: Indian Independence Bill — Hansard, House of Lords, 16 July 1947
sources.quote: Clause 1 sets up the two Independent dominions of India and Pakistan with effect from August 15. The word "independent" emphasizes the absence of any external restraint.

fact: 1947年英国仍维持战时配给制度：面包、土豆、肉类、衣物均按券配给；1947年燃料危机期间，家庭用电与供暖时数被严格限制。

sources.title: Clement Attlee — GOV.UK
sources.quote: Coal Industry Nationalisation Act 1946, Electricity Act 1947, Transport Act 1947: nationalised the coal industry, electricity utilities, railways and long-distance haulage.

fact: 1947年英国通过《电力法》（Electricity Act 1947）与《交通法》（Transport Act 1947），将电力与铁路国有化；铁路国有化于1948年1月1日生效，成立英国铁路（British Railways）。

sources.title: Clement Attlee — GOV.UK
sources.quote: Coal Industry Nationalisation Act 1946, Electricity Act 1947, Transport Act 1947: nationalised the coal industry, electricity utilities, railways and long-distance haulage. Town and Country Planning Act 1947: planning permission now required for land development.
